description: Search file contents by regex, or find files by name glob. Use instead of grep/rg/find/ls in terminal; ripgrep-backed and faster.
name: search_files

context.description: Content search only: context lines before and after each match.

file_glob.description: Content search only: restrict to files matching a glob (e.g. '*.py').

order.description: File search only. 'discovery' (default): fast bounded traversal order; 'modified': exact global newest-first, may scan the full tree.

output_mode.description: Content search only. 'content': matching lines with line numbers; 'files_only': file paths; 'count': match counts per file.

path.description: Directory or file to search in.

pattern.description: Regex for content search; glob for file search (e.g. '*.py', '*config*').
